subject: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can put together a firm pricing proposal. Please confirm or correct any numbers below.

Summary of what you shared (ask me to correct if I misunderstood):
- Primary product flow: end-user Q&A + optional document ingestion for context.
- Expected active users: ~10k monthly active users, peak daily active ~10k (light churn).
- Request frequency: ~2 requests/user/day on average.
- Profiled prompt length (avg): ~120 tokens.
- Profiled completion length (avg): ~450 tokens.
- Long-context usage: about 5% of requests will be >8k tokens, with an occasional need for 32k for multi-doc compiles; 128k not expected initially.

Quick derived estimates (please confirm):
- Avg tokens per request = prompt + completion = ~570 tokens.
- Monthly requests estimate = 10k users * 2 req/day * 30 days = 600k requests/month.
- Monthly token usage = 600k * 570 ≈ 342M tokens/month (0.342B).
- Long-context bucket: ~5% of 600k = 30k requests/month needing >=8k, and ~3k of those may need 32k occasionally.

Pricing questions / asks for you:
1) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M-tokens for this engagement (benchmark you want us to hit)?
2) Procurement timeline & SSO/PO requirements (approx date you need a signed agreement).
3) Any compliance docs we should route to security/procurement now (SOC 2, DPA, IP addendum)?

Next steps from our side: Jordan will draft an initial tiered pricing quote (base 8k context support + 32k add-on). I'll include an estimated monthly cost at a few per-1M-price points so you can pick the budget target that fits. Attaching the token profile CSV and a placeholder quote.

Attachments: acme-token-profile.csv (token distribution), redwood-pricing-quote.pdf (placeholder).

Thanks — can you confirm the monthly token estimate or send any usage logs you have (sample week)?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — this is great and mostly correct. A few clarifications inline: 

> - Expected active users: ~10k monthly active users
That's correct. Our product has ~10k MAU for the pilot group.

> - Request frequency: ~2 requests/user/day on average.
That's an average — during business hours it spikes to ~4 req/user for heavy users; overall daily average ~2.

> - Profiled prompt length (avg): ~120 tokens.
Confirm. Prompts tend to be short (~90-150 tokens).

> - Profiled completion length (avg): ~450 tokens.
Confirm. Some completions (summaries) go longer — up to 1k tokens — but those are the <10% tail.

> - Long-context usage: about 5% of requests will be >8k tokens, with an occasional need for 32k for multi-doc compiles; 128k not expected initially.
Correct — 5% >8k, and maybe ~0.5% will spike towards 32k when users upload large doc bundles. No 128k need right now.

A crude monthly calc using your numbers:
- Avg tokens/request = 120 + 450 = 570 tokens
- Monthly token estimate = 10,000 users * 2 * 30 * 570 = 342,000,000 tokens (~342M)
- Long-context: ~30k requests >=8k, ~3k hitting 32k occasionally.

Budget: for the pilot we are targeting ~$200 per 1M tokens (we expect to ask for committed discount once we ramp). Would you be able to propose a tiered discount schedule (e.g., list, 300M+, 1B+ thresholds)?

Procurement: we need a vendor onboarding packet and SOC 2. Procurement aims to have a PO signed by end of August if pricing and terms look reasonable.

Let me know what numbers you want to show Procurement and we'll route them.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
sam.patel@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Looping you both in — Sam at Acme confirmed the numbers below and gave a target of $200/1M tokens for the pilot (target PO by end of Aug). They expect ~342M tokens/month initially, with ~5% 8k requests and ~0.5% occasional 32k.

Can Jordan draft a tiered proposal with these inputs:
- Baseline: support for 8k context (list price & pilot price).
- 32k as an add-on (qty-based surcharge or separate bucket).
- Example tiers: list, 300M+, 1B+ committed monthly tokens.
- Include a committed discount path and a short term pilot pricing row that hits ~200/1M.

Marcus — want to flag procurement timeline (end of Aug) and the SOC2/DPA asks. Any redlines we should be prepared for on the pilot?

I attached the token profile and the placeholder quote.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme: Context length & token volume — pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — I can put together the tiered quote. Initial recommendation for a pilot offer: 

- Pilot (3 months minimum commit): 300M tokens/month commitment at $200/1M (as requested) — includes 8k context by default.
- 32k add-on: billable at incremental +25% over base per-1M for tokens that use extended context, with a reporting flag so Acme can see exact 32k usage.
- Volume discounts: 300M+ -> $180/1M; 1B+ -> $150/1M (annual committed).
- Overage: consumption beyond committed bucket billed at list price (we'll show list in quote).

I'll prepare a PDF quote and a short slide that maps their usage profile to monthly cost at $200, $180, and $150 per-1M so Procurement can evaluate. Marcus — if those discount levels look OK I will finalize and send to Marissa to share with Sam by Monday.

-Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
